what: On hover, the bent arrow of links like ”READ →” (a horizontal line with its left end bent upward, plus a chevron) stretches from 1em to 3em while redrawing the line from the start (dash 462 from 154 → 0, viewBox 120×80 → 360×80, chevron +230, .4s circ.inOut). On release it shrinks back to its own length in .3s circ.out. When applied to the whole card, the arrow stretches wherever the pointer is on the card

options.[data-fx-part=arrow]: Arrow cell — if empty, the part inserts the graphic. If drawing it yourself, put data-fx-part on the horizontal line in the svg="line", data-fx-part on the chevron="head"

note: On touch devices or reduced-motion settings it does not expand, only the arrow stays

from.where: index.html service card READ · SEE ALL NEWS · photo strip name (original js-link--arrow-h: tl1 .4 circ.inOut · tl2 .3 circ.out)
